fields.description: How long a fetched ERP actuals period (one fiscal_year + accounting_period combination) stays cached before the next request for it re-fetches from the ERP instead of reusing the cached copy. A different period (a different month or year) is never affected by this - it gets its own cache entry and its own countdown, fetched fresh the first time anything asks for it.
fields.label: ERP Actuals Cache Duration (minutes)

fields.description: How often (in minutes) the scheduled job (budget_mis.api.erp_data_sync.refresh_erp_data) re-fetches every stored ERP Data period (both Actuals and Trial Balance) from PeopleSoft and refreshes its record in place. Unrelated to ERP Actuals Cache Duration above - that one governs the old live-fetch Redis cache; this one governs how often the ERP Data doctype itself is kept up to date, independent of any report request.
fields.label: ERP Actuals Sync Interval (minutes)
Testing Mode (disable auth + encryption for Postman)

fields.description: Testing Mode automatically turns off this many minutes after it's enabled.
fields.label: Testing Mode Duration (minutes)
